# Aardvark Safaris Tanzania

> Privately guided safaris in Tanzania and across East Africa — luxury tented camps, Great Migration, Kilimanjaro treks, Zanzibar, and tailor-made itineraries built around conservation and community.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Aardvark Safaris Tanzania and signature journeys.
- [About](/about): Our story, team, and commitment to ethical tourism.
- [Destinations](/destinations): National parks and regions across Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda and Southern Africa.
- [Itineraries](/itineraries): Signature trips from 1-day excursions to 12-day expeditions.
- [Experiences](/experiences): Game drives, walking safaris, balloon flights, and cultural encounters.
- [Camps & Lodges](/camps): Hand-picked luxury camps and lodges.
- [Blog](/blog): Stories, guides and dispatches from the Tanzanian wild.
- [Plan a Trip](/plan-trip): Request a free, no-obligation tailor-made quote.
- [FAQ](/faq): Migration timing, visas, health, payments, and cancellation policy.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with our Arusha-based team.
